asset_set: Questionnaire Q1 option 1 — Building a robot kit

questionnaire.question_text: Which task would you enjoy more?

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only
art_style.shading: single cel shadow ellipse under robot body and wrists — no cast shadows on transparent edge
art_style.texture: none on skin; subtle wood grain suggestion on bench via 3 parallel lines max
art_style.mood: curious maker energy — approachable STEM hobby, not industrial factory
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame

accent.name: KursoKo teal
accent.use: robot chest LED dots, wire insulation tips, shirt cuff pinstripe

secondary.name: lavender
secondary.use: secondary wire bundle, small washer accents

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint warm #FFF8F0 highlight on knuckle tops only
color.accent_rule: teal appears on 2–3 small areas max — not a background wash

lighting.highlight: small curved highlights on screwdriver shaft and robot dome
lighting.shadow: flat #2D2D2D at 12% opacity under hands and robot base

pose.camera_distance: medium-close — hands occupy lower 55% of frame

left_hand.action: pins robot chassis flat against bench
left_hand.grip: spread fingers, thumb on far edge of chassis
left_hand.position: lower-left quadrant, wrist angled toward center

right_hand.action: presses brass gear onto axle post
right_hand.grip: precision pinch between thumb and index finger

pose.gesture_summary: mid-assembly freeze frame — one part being fitted
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

accessories.placement: both hands — fingertips cut out exposing skin for dexterity

subject.scene_narrative: A pair of gloved hands assembles a cute beginner robot kit on a light wooden bench. The robot body is half-built with colorful wires and a loose gear waiting to slot in — the moment right before a satisfying click into place. The scene reads instantly as hands-on engineering play, not factory labor.

primary_objects.name: unfinished robot body
primary_objects.detail: round head dome, open chest cavity showing wire harness, two teal LED dots

primary_objects.name: loose wire leads
primary_objects.detail: red and teal tips, gently curved not tangled

subject.environment: light birch workbench surface strip across bottom third — fades to transparent at edges, cream paper sheet under robot

composition.layout: diagonal workflow line from screwdriver → robot → gear hand
composition.negative_space: transparent margin top and sides — 48px safe zone for card crop
depth_layers: background: bench edge only — no wall
composition.thumbnail_readability: robot silhouette + two hand shapes readable at 160px width

generation.negative_prompt: face, portrait, person head, text, watermark, logo, letter R, border frame, sticker outline, photorealistic, 3d render, cgi, blurry, dark background, factory, industrial horror, guns, blood

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector education illustration, 640x640 square, transparent PNG background. KursoKo career quiz choice image for activity "Building a robot kit". Style: friendly flat vector with consistent 2px dark outline #2D2D2D, solid fills, minimal cel shadow under hands only — match KursoKo RIASEC sticker art family but NO letter, NO border frame, NO text on image. Scene: two forearms with thin grey work gloves (fingertips exposed) assembling a cute beginner robot kit on a light birch workbench strip.
